header.title: Indiscriminate AI de-risking leaves derated electrification, aerospace, transports attractive

s01_bottom_line.text: The speaker says pockets of electrification, civil aerospace and transports have derated/sold off heavily and look attractive, with visibility into 2027 providing a margin of safety.
The article suggests these derated areas are where the speaker would cautiously add, given low net positioning and convexity.
This is a low-conviction, opportunistic valuation-dislocation call on areas swept up in the AI de-risking; it does not quantify the earnings or the mispricing for specific securities.

items.text: Last week saw the biggest selling of tech ever recorded in the GS prime book.
The median equity has declined well in excess of 10%, even as the S&P has compartmentalized the rise in energy. ⟨cited figures: approximate⟩
Pockets of electrification look interesting; they have derated a lot and there is visibility into 2027 giving a margin of safety.
Many aerospace assets, particularly civil, have sold off and look incredibly attractive.
There is convexity in the transports/energy-resolution trade given how low net positioning has become after heavy selling.
The de-risking has been indiscriminate, throwing the baby out with the bathwater across nominal assets and commodities.
